marks_structure.extra_time_note: Haan — 15 minute reading time milta hai. Is time mein sirf paper padho, rough work ya answers likhna allowed nahi.
marks_structure.internal_assessment_note: Theory mein 56 mein se kam se kam 20 aur practical mein 30 mein se 10 marks laane zaroori hain. Dono mein alag-alag pass karna hoga.

paper_overview.sets_note: RBSE mein usually multiple sets hote hain. Har set mein same questions hote hain, sirf order alag hota hai.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono mein attempt kar sakte hain. Mixed bhi allowed hai.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Section C (Long Answer) aur Section D (Essay) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: RBSE ka syllabus NCERT par based hai lekin RBSE ke specific patterns, previous year questions aur SP Examination Idea jaise reference books bhi zaroori hain.

sample_paper_vs_model_paper.model_paper: Official RBSE website se download karo — rajeduboard.rajasthan.gov.in > Books/Old Papers/Model Questions > Model Papers 2026.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.question_bank: SP Examination Idea Physics (Science Publications, Jaipur) — RBSE ke liye sabse popular reference book. Chapter-wise MCQs, Short and Long Q hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Physics paper mein 6 types ke questions aate hain — MCQ (0.5), Fill Blank (0.5), Very Short (1), Short (1.5), Long (3), Essay (4).

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option ka letter (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna hota hai. Koi explanation nahi chahiye. 0.5 mark ke liye zyaada time mat lgao.
types.mostly_from: Har chapter se aate hain — definitions, units, dimensions, formulas, device names, properties. Chapter 14 (Semiconductors) se sabse zyaada MCQs.

types.type: Fill in the Blanks (Rikt Sthan Bhariye)
types.how_to_attempt: Ek word ya ek formula likhna hota hai. SI unit, dimensional formula, specific values.
types.mostly_from: SI units, formulas, constants (e = 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C), device characteristics.

types.how_to_attempt: Definition, law statement, ya ek-do sentence mein answer. Formula bhi likh sakte ho.
types.mostly_from: Definitions (Gauss's law, Faraday's law, Bohr postulates), conditions (TIR conditions, resonance), simple numerical answers.

types.how_to_attempt: Short reasoning questions, small derivations, easy numericals, comparisons. 1.5 marks = 1 mark concept/law + 0.5 mark formula/diagram.
types.mostly_from: All chapters — law with formula, numerical (1 step), comparison questions, small diagram questions.

types.how_to_attempt: Full derivation with diagram. Diagram = 1 mark (usually). Steps numbered. Final result boxed. 3 marks = diagram (1) + steps (1.5) + result (0.5).
types.mostly_from: Standard derivations — Gauss's law applications, Biot-Savart, potentiometer, lens/mirror formula, AC circuits.

types.how_to_attempt: Biggest derivation of the paper. Diagram compulsory. Detailed explanation. 4 marks = diagram (1) + derivation steps (2) + result + application (1).
types.mostly_from: High-weightage derivations — Moving Charges and Magnetism (most frequent for 4-mark), AC circuits, Optics derivations.

paper_pattern.note: RBSE Physics theory paper = 56 marks. 4 sections. 52 questions total. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes (15 min reading time extra).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Section C (Long Answer) aur Section D (Essay) mein internal choice (OR option) milta hai.

sections.name: Section A — Objective (MCQ + Fill Blanks + Very Short Answer)
sections.type: MCQ (18) + Fill Blanks (10) + Very Short Answer (9)
sections.notes: Sare 37 attempt karne hain. Koi choice nahi. MCQ and fill blanks = 0.5 mark — sirf option/word likhna hai.

sections.name: Section B — Short Answer
sections.breakdown: 10 short answer questions × 1.5 marks each = 15 marks
sections.notes: Sare 10 attempt karne hain. 4-6 lines mein answer. Formula + 1-2 steps + answer.

sections.name: Section C — Long Answer
sections.breakdown: 3 long answer questions × 3 marks each = 9 marks. Internal OR choice milta hai.
sections.notes: 3 questions, har ek mein OR choice. Diagram banana zaroori hai — diagram = 1 mark.

sections.name: Section D — Essay / Very Long Answer
sections.breakdown: 1 essay type question × 4 marks = 4 marks. Internal OR choice milta hai.
sections.notes: 1 question, OR choice milti hai. Biggest derivation of paper. Diagram aur complete steps zaroori.

marks_distribution.marks_summary_note: A(23) + B(15) + C(9) + D(4) = ~51 theory + 30 practical + 14 sessional = 100 (exact breakup varies year to year)

sections.breakdown: 3 long answer questions × 3 marks each = 9 marks. Internal OR choice milta hai.

sections.breakdown: 1 essay type question × 4 marks = 4 marks. Internal OR choice milta hai.
